<div class="review-text">
I don't normally like VR video games. I use my headset 99.99% of the time just for VRChat. However, Into the Radius is the single exception. It's very good. It's got nice clicky-clacky items and guns, and it feels good to move treasure around in my backpack and home base. Shooting certain guns releases serotonin in my brain, too.<br>
<br>
<h3>Mod Recommendations</h3>
<br>
My first play-through, I used (and would recommend):<br>
<br>
- <a href="https://www.nexusmods.com/intotheradiusvr/mods/41">Scavenger Mod</a><br>
---- Shop disable mode<br>
---- Standard preset<br>
- <a href="https://www.nexusmods.com/intotheradiusvr/mods/178">Carry primaries with folding stocks</a>, either version <i>(optional)</i><br>
---- <i>A mod like this doesn't make sense for the balance of the base game, but makes perfect sense for scavenger mode!</i>
